title: The Letter of Saint Alder's
author: Theo Joubert
blurb: Kestrel Coldharbour, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
